name: Skylib
english_description: Version 1.8 of Skylib, an English-language LPMud library boot-banner'd as the "Divided Sky Distribution Lib," in the Discworld/Nightmare lineage: soul-based emotes, a directory-based per-verb command dispatcher, round-time combat, and guilds, built around the same command-dispatch style as Discworld rather than the driver's native add_action(). Content-wise this is an honest work-in-progress skeleton rather than a finished game -- the login banner itself says "this mud is still under construction" -- with no designed adventure zones, only the standard five starting guilds (fighter, mage, thief, cleric, artisan), a training dummy, and a small template area of generic rooms (tavern, garden, shops). The archive itself also includes deliberately-broken LPC-error teaching examples and a dead/superseded alternate room-topography system left in place as reference material rather than active content. Like imud/foundation2, this lib makes a real outbound Intermud-3 socket connection at boot (to a near-certainly-defunct 1990s host) and should not be swept into high-frequency automated re-boot loops.
